{{Elections in Florida sidebar}}

The '''2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida''' will be held on November 8, 2022, to elect the 28 [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. representatives]] from [[Florida]], one from each of the state's 28 [[Florida's congressional districts|congressional districts]]. The [[Primary election|primary]] was held on August 23, 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Election Dates - Division of Elections - Florida Department of State |url=https://dos.myflorida.com/elections/for-voters/election-dates/ |access-date=2022-06-28 |website=dos.myflorida.com}}</ref> The elections will coincide with the [[2022 United States Senate election in Florida]], [[2022 United States House of Representatives elections|other elections]] to the House of Representatives, [[2022 United States Senate elections|other elections]] to the [[United States Senate]], and various [[2022 United States elections#State elections|state]] and [[2022 United States elections#Local elections|local elections]].

Republican [[Matt Gaetz]], who has represented the district since 2017, was re-elected with 64.6% of the vote in 2020.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|last1=Wasserman|first1=David|last2=Andrews|first2=Sophie|last3=Saenger|first3=Leo|last4=Cohen|first4=Lev|last5=Flinn|first5=Ally|last6=Tatarsky|first6=Griff|display-authors=1|title=2020 House Tracker|url=https://cookpolitical.com/2020-house-vote-tracker|url-status=live|access-date=2021-07-20|website=[[The Cook Political Report]]|language=en|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201104200403/https://cookpolitical.com/2020-house-vote-tracker |archive-date=November 4, 2020 }}</ref> Gaetz is running for re-election.

The boundaries of the district have been redrawn from 2020 determined by the [[2020 United States redistricting cycle|2020 redistricting cycle]].

{{see also|Florida's 28th congressional district}}
Republican [[Carlos A. Giménez|Carlos Giménez]], who has represented the 26th district since 2021, flipped that district and was elected with 52% of the vote in 2020.<ref name=":0" /> Giménez is running for re-election in the new 28th district.

The boundaries of the district have been redrawn from 2020 determined by the [[2020 United States redistricting cycle|2020 redistricting cycle]].

This district is included on the list of Republican-held seats the [[Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee]] is targeting in 2022.<ref name='dccc'>{{cite web|date=May 6, 2021|title=House Democrats roll out offensive targets for 2022|website= The Hill|author=Tal Axelford|url=https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/546739-house-democrats-roll-out-offensive-targets-for-2022}}</ref>
